name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis, including an in-driver taste-funnel explore state, → /spec:genesis-design) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.40.1 — explore folds into the driver (specs/20260827/02-genesis-explore-state.md): the taste funnel's Round 0 (fresh UX research, position briefs, starter tokens, Sonnet-built style tiles, the deterministic check, the gallery, the cull to two) becomes driver states between `MENUS` and `FINALISTS` — `research-done` → `positions-authored` → `tiles-built` → `tiles-culled` — entered for visual archetypes (`web-app`, `mobile-app`, `realtime-trading`, `desktop-app`) and written `skipped` for every other archetype. A design the user already made (a Claude Design export or any local mock bundle) now enters as an **external candidate** (`--mark external --file <dir>`) and skips the funnel entirely — no research brief owed, no `dc-extract`. The two culled positions (or the external candidate) render inside each racing finalist's own scaffold and component library as the tournament's `style-tile` probe task, so the user judges stack and look together in one gallery; `--mark picked` records `design-pick.json`'s `winner` alongside `tournament.winner`. Round-1 interactive prototypes and persona walkthroughs are retired — the booted finalist is now the interactive candidate. `/spec:genesis-explore` is deleted: its command file, its `shared-for` map entry (`/spec:genesis` now serves § Design Canon directly), its `entrypoints.json` rows, and its arm in `genesis-state-gate.sh`'s `case` lists are all gone — a stray `/spec:genesis-explore` prompt now falls through the hook untouched. A repo-wide sweep (`tests/consistency/genesis-doctrine.test.js`) pins that no live surface still names the retired command. 7.40.0 — the tournament of scaffolds (specs/20260827/01-genesis-tournament.md): genesis-driver.js gains four states between MENUS and DECIDE for tournament archetypes (`web-app`, `realtime-trading`, `backend-api`, `mobile-app`, `desktop-app`) — `FINALISTS` (the session names 2–3 finalist stack combinations to race, printing a go/no-go cost line before any spend), `RACE` (driver-only: scaffolds, gates, and boots each finalist for real into `.claude/genesis/tournament/finalists/<name>/` through `smoke.sh`'s existing boot contract), `PROBE` (the session builds one probe slice per finalist with Sonnet workers under a two-retry cap per task, recording harness-reported tokens, never estimated), and `PICK` (the driver re-runs gate + boot post-probe and writes `tournament/benchmark.json`/`.md` + `gallery.html` — executed evidence informs the user's pick, it never makes it). Every other archetype still derives `MENUS → DECIDE` directly and writes no `tournament/` directory. `--mark menus-done` now additionally requires a `- archetype: <key>` line in the brief's `## Picks` (one of the eight registry keys) and stores `status.archetype`. At `decided`, the winner is re-scaffolded clean into the project root — the probe slice was built under retry caps with no spec and no review and must never become the foundation — and the raced copies (`tournament/finalists/`, `tournament/logs/`) are deleted once an ADR cites `tournament/benchmark.md` as evidence. Every driver state now prints its own `Doctrine: spec/doctrine/genesis.md § Genesis: …` pointer; `/spec:genesis`'s `## Per-state judgment pointers` section is deleted, since the choreography it restated now has one binding home instead of two. 7.39.2 — workflow scripts return to review scope (specs/20260825/05-workflow-scripts-in-review-scope.md): this repo's `pipelineOwnedPaths` entry for `spec/workflows/wf-*.js` is deleted. It was written for `build-workflows.js`'s generated output; that generator, its gate step, and the workflows build layer were all removed in `61e2e5a` (2026-08-17) and the exclusion outlived them, hiding an unplanned edit to a frozen workflow script from scope-reconcile and pruning the file from collision-closure's literals leg — the blind spot 7.37.1 worked around with an enumerated-file test. Now an out-of-plan edit to `wf-research.js`/`wf-enforce.js` is a visible review finding and the literals leg can see inside them; the enumerated sweep stays as a standing gate. Three new tests exercise the repo's real config through the real entrypoints; the host-declared `pipelineOwnedPaths` mechanism is unchanged and remains fully honored.
